item.title: GitLost: We Tricked GitHub's AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
item.description:
📝 mp4 Introduction GitHub recently launched GitHub Agentic Workflows, pairing GitHub Actions (GitHub’s automation system for running tasks in response to repository events) with an AI agent backed by Claude or GitHub Copilot. What are GitHub Agentic Workflows. GitHub Agentic Workflows let teams automate their interactions with code repositories using natural language.
🔗 Read more: https://noma.security/blog/gitlost-how-we-tricked-githubs-ai-agent-into-leaking-private-repos/
